summary: Full-stack test of Yue Fung precision B2B site. Backend pytest suite (8/8) passed. Frontend tested on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): landing sections render in order, floating navbar + quote CTA scroll works, mobile hamburger opens/closes and quote CTA works, no horizontal overflow, process nodes 01-05 all present. Quote form: client-side validation shows all required errors + invalid-email message, .exe upload rejected with 'Unsupported file type', happy path with delivered@resend.dev + test.pdf submits successfully with reference ID YF-2610-45F05. Admin dashboard with seeded cookie lists 4 quote requests, row click opens detail panel, status change to 'reviewing' succeeds, attachment Download link present. Visitor dashboard with seeded cookie shows dashboard-empty (0 rows) and NO status actions (correct access control). Unauthenticated /dashboard shows signin prompt + google button + back-home link.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero heading in DOM is 'Built to Perform.' (relies on CSS text-transform to render uppercase). Harmless, worth noting if copy ever styled differently.
test_credentials: Seeded sessions in /app/memory/test_credentials.md worked as httpOnly session_token cookie.
seed_data_creation: Submitted one TEST quote (ref YF-2610-45F05) via UI happy path; now visible in admin table.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical E2E flows verified end-to-end. Admin table currently has 4 quotes incl. the TEST_ one from this run. Visitor dashboard correctly empty. If re-testing, consider cleaning TEST_ prefixed quotes from MongoDB quote_requests collection.
